4 أَلَجَّهُ He continued him, or made him to persevere, or persist, in a thing: accord. to Lh.: for he explains يَمُدُّهُمْ in the Kur, ii., 14, by يُلِجُّهُمْ: but ISd doubts whether he had heard this from the Arabs: and adds, that he, himself, had not heard أَلْجَجْتُهُ. (L.) ＝
-A2- الجّ القَوْمُ The people cried out; raised a cry. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, and القَوْمُ ↓ لجّ , The people uttered confused cries. (TA.) ―
-b3- الجّت الإِبِلُ The camels uttered cries: (K:) and in like manner الغَنَمُ, the sheep or goats. (TA.) ＝
-A3- See 2.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
